deviations.title: Two AMD capacity facts violate the protocol amount rule (missing scaling word)
deviations.protocol_clause: amounts: 'an amount is recorded only when the quote carries an explicit thousands/millions/billions word and an explicit currency token' (protocol SHA d5f2e320f6e964e7533f5de25da8a7a17ff61c116263961cbfd138f4931df149; CREDIT_TERMS_PILOT_PROTOCOL.md line 68)
deviations.impact: The two AMD amounts are recorded though they lack the required scaling word; the pilot's own validator does not enforce the scaling word, so the frozen table and public report print 641,666,667 and 850,000,000 USD.

deviations.impact: The 2024 CAT package states two $100 million sub-limit addenda within the 364-Day Aggregate Commitment, exactly parallel to the two CAT 2022 addenda rows that were captured. source_evidence.json records 3 rows for 2024 vs 5 rows for 2022. This is a cross-year annotation inconsistency, not a pairing error.

deviations.title: Evidence set is an audited subset (sequence-1 8-K body only), not an exhaustive whole-package annotation
deviations.detail: Every one of the 100 bound facts references the sequence-1 8-K document. No exhibit fact is recorded. The pilot is therefore an audited subset, not an exhaustive whole-package search. This audit separately inspected all text-bearing exhibits for explicit paired terms and found none beyond PM, but did not exhaustively annotate every exhibit-only term.

deviations.title: jev_or_model_calls: 0 means no runtime JEV/model request, not no model involvement
deviations.detail: metrics.json reports jev_or_model_calls: 0 and the protocol forbids 'JEV or other model calls' during the deterministic pipeline. That is a runtime-instrumentation count. The hand-authored annotations, reviewer notes, protocol prose and public report were authored by a language model (opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash). No additional runtime model request during the pilot does not mean no model involvement.

deviations.title: No economic inference from source-only counts
deviations.detail: The 1/12 and 0/12 figures are measurement-feasibility counts over a fixed hash-selected 12. They are not prevalence, not an effect size, and carry no market or outcome information. The pilot report already labels the result as a measurement feasibility pilot, not a population prevalence estimate or economic result.

recommended_corrections.target: AMD rows in credit_terms_pilot/source_evidence.json (and the hand-authored SOURCE_EVIDENCE constant)
recommended_corrections.action: Record old/new capacity as null for the AMD ZT and receivables rows because the quotes carry no explicit scaling word, per protocol clause 'amounts'; alternatively keep the raw figure only with an explicit off-protocol provenance note. The frozen protocol must not be edited to relax the scaling-word requirement.

Add the two $100 million local-currency addendum rows, mirroring the 2022 CAT rows, binding the exact quotes and offsets listed in DEV-2; keep them separate from the $3.15 billion 364-Day Aggregate Commitment.

State in the report that the evidence table audits the sequence-1 8-K body only (audited subset), while the paired-term search was extended to exhibits; do not claim an exhaustive whole-package annotation.
State that annotations and reviews were authored by opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash and that jev_or_model_calls: 0 is a runtime count, not a claim of no model involvement.

concurrency_note.detail: The pilot-authoring session (opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash, PID 48295) was still running while this audit ran and rewrote the pilot artifacts at 2026-10-03 04:19:53. In an earlier transient snapshot the preservation guard compared the raw SHA256 of HISTORICAL_CREDIT_COVERAGE_PROTOCOL.md (a683359b...) against the canonical-JSON digest of the historical protocol (726caa85...), so 'verify' raised 'Historical credit coverage protocol changed'. The authoring session then corrected protected_manifest() to digest historical_credit_coverage/protocol.json and to record the markdown SHA256 separately; 'verify' now passes on the audited snapshot (code SHA a6083152...). This audit is valid for the recorded snapshot hashes; freeze the authoring session before treating the pilot as final.

outcome: For the audited snapshot, all 12 filings and all 100 bound facts are internally exact, and the pairing result 1 paired maturity / 0 paired capacity survives reviewed package text. No explicit same-facility old->new pair detectable in the original exhibits is omitted by source_evidence.json. Two open deviations remain: the two AMD capacity facts are off-protocol because they lack a scaling word, and two CAT 2024 local-currency sub-limit rows stated in the 8-K are missing. The pilot is an audited subset, not an exhaustive whole-package search; the annotations were model-authored (opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash); and no economic conclusion follows from the source-only counts.
